title: Jagged Spicy Argentinian Beef Skewers
description: A spicy and savory Argentinian dish featuring gochujang and salt-baked beef skewers, perfect for a sick day or a weeknight dinner. This macrobiotic-friendly recipe is made with wholesome ingredients and can be prepared in under an hour.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together gochujang, salt, black pepper, garlic, and mustard to make the marinade.
Add the beef cubes to the marinade and toss to coat.
Thread the marinated beef cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each cube.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and drizzle with olive oil.
Bake the skewers in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until the beef is cooked to an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
Remove the skewers from the oven and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
